notes.title: Super Win the Game release date announced!
notes.notes:
http://www.superwinthegame.com/img/keyart_880.png

Hi y'all! Exciting news today! Super Win the Game will be coming out October 1, and we have a new trailer to celebrate! Check it out on the Steam store or at superwinthegame.com!
